_about: The shape of a rendered-loops manifest for dio-layer.js (R4). Not used yet: his body waits for R13. Open index.html?dio=loops&loops=<this file's path> once real frames exist. rect and head are in world units (prototype B's SVG space: he stands at x 800, feet at y 672). Each loop is a list of frames or a video. A recipe step plays its loop once, then repeats from 'hold' (a frame index, or seconds for video) while he waits for your tap.
